conclusion: No double reservation introduced in tested caller paths. Two graph-path prepare calls are replacement attempts; only final canonical packet is attached. Canonical, graph, operational state and original objective each occur once.

equations.no_graph: prepare reserves operational separator+text; final prompt = canonical + operational. Reserved budget is consumed by later append, not appended a second time.
equations.with_graph: prepare reserves graph separator+graph+SYSTEM+operational+256byte margin; final prompt = last canonical + graph + operational; reserved byte total equals final prompt bytes +SYSTEMbytes+256.
equations.chars: With explicit max_projection_chars, packet_char_cap already subtracts SYSTEM+TAREFA wrapper; reserved_context_chars excludes SYSTEM, so it is not deducted twice.
equations.handoff: coordination.get and runtime.preview/submit pass one operational_projection to prepare_queue; provider reuses supplied memory_packet; augment returns existing graph packet without adding it again.

residuals.detail: No-graph reserve does not include SYSTEM/TAREFA wrapper bytes. Existing opmem.attach/provider guards validate actual assembled size later. This is missing headroom, not a new double count; no correction attempted.
Maximum-mode <=24000 char-cap sentinel remains original behavior; real explicit envelope controls.enforce_packet still runs downstream. Analysis did not change policy.

New envelope_total_* fields describe the prepare-time estimate including future reserved components; downstream attach updates context_bytes. Do not add reserved fields again to already attached final context_bytes.

scope: Actual copied prepare_queue/_attach/augment/opmem.attach/request_controls plus frozen staged prepare, synthetic13source sealed corpus/projection/graph. coordination/runtime/provider call chain inspected statically only; no jobs/providers/graph CLI executed.

installer.contract: Plan files[source,destination,sha256,baseline(nullnew)]; validates all before mutation, confines destinations, rawbyte backups, cooperative lock/rechecks, atomic replace, rollback guarded by current pins; retains new-file rollback artifacts and writes success/failure pin receipt. Parent executes after authorized GO; no extra human confirmation added.
